newsitem.title: USA: ETC w/tci names Elliot Gerson President.
newsitem.headline: ETC w/tci names Elliot Gerson President.

text.p: ETC w/tci, an education and communications subsidiary of TCI Technology Ventures Inc, said on Wednesday that Elliot Gerson had been named ETC President and Chief Operating Officer.
Gerson was Executive Vice President of the United Health Care Corp, ETC said in a statement.
He would oversee daily operations and new business developments for ETC, effective immediately, it said.

At United HealthCare, Gerson was responsible for national accounts, the international division and all specialty managed care businesses. Before he was Executive Vice President of MetraHealth Companies inc, which was acquired by United HealthCare in 1995.
